Exact numbers compared over runs finished in both (no run of mine is unfinished; the prototype's 158 unfinished runs are dropped from my counts; MET's join clause alone counted twice with OLDEST for the prototype's IN-TURN runs, deviations 33). Of 82 census cells, the columns "a clock of four equal ticks" and "a clock giving parts off at four ticks" are equal in every cell, with and without the filter. The column "a series giving parts off at two ticks or more" differs in 8 places, all in rules the prototype added itself (the family of STEPS-k by the kind of the parent), mine always higher:

| cell | column | mine | prototype |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fbp/STEPS-1:join/CAP-3 | past: runs with a series giving parts off at 2+ ticks | 4 | 2 |
| fbp/STEPS-1:offshoot/FLOOR1 | past: runs with a series giving parts off at 2+ ticks | 6 | 4 |
| fbp/STEPS-2:offshoot/FLOOR1 | nopast: runs with a series giving parts off at 2+ ticks | 26 | 24 |

These runs are listed in `replay_census_cells.json`, and those of the cells with at most 30 runs are replayed birth by birth (parents, every input with its holders at the start of the round, demand, fresh, usable and barred counts) in `replay_census_listings.jsonl.gz`. The prototype's per-run census is not in compare.json, so which runs differ cannot be named; no verdict rests on this column. The column "bound exceeded" differs in 34 cells: it is the count's bound (deviations 38), and the prototype's count of start knots acting is not disclosed. Other comparisons, all equal: the ladder's start-roster returns in all 444 finished runs (4 cut short by the guard in both); P4's round 1 on Ring(5,3), Ring(7,3), Ring(9,3); the two-knot case's parts, series, own knots (6 a period, 2 a round with Y barred) and test with X barred; the 80 numberings of the two-knot C-iii case and the 112 of the near case (the same sets); the 112 of the case under STEPS-2 for offshoots of joins; all 44 C-iii tests of the prototype are among mine (same run, Y size, X size). Run 4 finds more: BY-COUNT on DW(5,3), Ring(7,3) and Ring(9,3) under STEPS-2 with COPY-LAW(CANCEL-OFFSHOOT) (X up to 8 members, j = 1, and X of the same form as Y, which the prototype left out). compare.json's "shifts" rows: {"compared": 3488, "differ": 110, "same": 3378}; every difference is a numbering the prototype passes and run 5 does not, explained by run 5 testing one clock of each form (deviations 42).
